strings.zh: 急冻鸟『Freee——za！
strings.en: Articuno: Freee-za!

strings.zh: 你也到这双子岛的最深处来啦。{SCROLL}我本来以为只要到达最深处,{NEWLINE}就能够见到沉睡中的盖欧卡,{CLEAR}但没想到却被传说中的急冻鸟{CLEAR}给挡住了前进的道路。{SCROLL}它像是这里的守卫一样{NEWLINE}制造了冰块阻止我前进。{CLEAR}这么厉害的精灵我还是第一次见,{CLEAR}我估计它的战斗力至少得有53万吧！
strings.en: So you made it to the depths of the{NEWLINE}Seafoam Islands too.{SCROLL}I thought that once I got to the{NEWLINE}bottom, I’d find Kyogre sleeping here.{SCROLL}But the legendary Articuno is blocking{NEWLINE}the way.{SCROLL}It’s like a guard. It made walls of ice{NEWLINE}to stop me going any farther.{SCROLL}I’ve never seen such a powerful{NEWLINE}Pokémon. I bet its power level is at{CLEAR}least 530,000!
strings.notes: 53万 is a Dragon Ball reference (Frieza’s power level).

strings.zh: 厚重而坚硬的冰块,{NEWLINE}用一般的办法无法挪动。
strings.en: The ice is thick and hard. Ordinary{NEWLINE}means won’t move it.

strings.zh: 因为熔岩蜗牛散发热量的关系,{NEWLINE}冰块开始融化了！
strings.en: The heat from Magcargo is starting to{NEWLINE}melt the ice!

strings.zh: 冰块全都融化了！
strings.en: The ice has melted away completely!

strings.zh: 因为火焰鸟散发热量的关系,{NEWLINE}冰块开始融化了！
strings.en: The heat from Moltres is starting to{NEWLINE}melt the ice!

strings.zh: 急冻鸟已经没有战斗的力气了,{NEWLINE}要收服它吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Articuno has no strength left to fight.{NEWLINE}Catch it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:FF01:200}请等一下！{VAR:FF01:100}
strings.en: {VAR:FF01:200}Please wait!{VAR:FF01:100}

strings.zh: 我研究双子岛的{NEWLINE}盖欧卡沉睡传说好长时间了,{CLEAR}急冻鸟出现在这里绝不是偶然。{CLEAR}根据我的推测,急冻鸟在这里{CLEAR}是负责压制盖欧卡能量的,{CLEAR}一旦急冻鸟被抓走,{CLEAR}盖欧卡很可能就会{CLEAR}从几万年的沉睡中醒来,{CLEAR}然后造成难以估量的生态灾难。{SCROLL}为了保护生态平衡,{NEWLINE}请你不要捕捉急冻鸟好吗？{SCROLL}要停止捕捉急冻鸟吗？
strings.en: I’ve been studying the legend of Kyogre{NEWLINE}sleeping in the Seafoam Islands for a{CLEAR}long time.{SCROLL}Articuno being here is no coincidence.{NEWLINE}My guess is that it’s here to hold{CLEAR}Kyogre’s power in check.{SCROLL}If Articuno is caught, Kyogre could{NEWLINE}wake from a sleep of tens of thousands{CLEAR}of years...{SCROLL}...and cause an ecological disaster{NEWLINE}beyond measure.{SCROLL}To protect the balance of nature, would{NEWLINE}you please not catch Articuno?{SCROLL}Stop trying to catch Articuno?

strings.zh: 谢谢你愿意放弃这个机会！{SCROLL}你好不容易走到这地底深处,{NEWLINE}我却让你无功而返,{CLEAR}实在是不好意思。{CLEAR}这个就当做是我任性要求的补偿吧！
strings.en: Thank you for giving up this chance!{SCROLL}You worked so hard to come all the way{NEWLINE}down here, and I’m sending you back{CLEAR}empty-handed. I’m truly sorry.{SCROLL}Please take this to make up for my{NEWLINE}selfish request!

strings.zh: 请不要这样说,{NEWLINE}一旦急冻鸟被抓走{CLEAR}盖欧卡很可能就会{CLEAR}从几万年的沉睡中醒来,{CLEAR}然后造成难以估量的生态灾难。{SCROLL}为了保护生态平衡,{NEWLINE}请你不要捕捉急冻鸟好吗？{SCROLL}要停止捕捉急冻鸟吗？
strings.en: Please don’t say that. If Articuno is{NEWLINE}caught, Kyogre could wake from a sleep{CLEAR}of tens of thousands of years...{SCROLL}...and cause an ecological disaster{NEWLINE}beyond measure.{SCROLL}To protect the balance of nature, would{NEWLINE}you please not catch Articuno?{SCROLL}Stop trying to catch Articuno?

strings.zh: 远古的精灵雕像,充满了神秘感。
strings.en: An ancient Pokémon statue. It’s{NEWLINE}shrouded in mystery.

strings.zh: 双子岛、盖欧卡、急冻鸟……{NEWLINE}要研究的东西实在是太多了。
strings.en: The Seafoam Islands, Kyogre,{NEWLINE}Articuno...{SCROLL}There’s just so much to research.

strings.zh: 带来滔天洪水的……{NEWLINE}称之为海皇……{CLEAR}莫非大海就是由这……{CLEAR}灵创造……{CLEAR}无法控制……{CLEAR}……抽出化为蓝色宝……{CLEAR}封印于此……
strings.en: ...brought the raging flood... called{NEWLINE}the Sea Emperor...{SCROLL}Could it be that the sea was created by{NEWLINE}this... spirit...{SCROLL}...could not be controlled...{SCROLL}...drawn out and turned into a blue...{NEWLINE}...sealed here...

strings.zh: 电力有限,价高者得。{NEWLINE}——火箭动力发电厂
strings.en: Power is limited. Highest bidder wins.{NEWLINE}-Rocket Power Plant

strings.zh: 你在发电厂越努力,{NEWLINE}这个世界就越光明。{CLEAR}——火箭动力发电厂
strings.en: Work harder for a brighter world!{NEWLINE}-Rocket Power Plant

strings.zh: 前段时间研究口袋妖怪传说的专家{NEWLINE}秀力博士来了一趟关东,{CLEAR}我于是找他聊了一些{CLEAR}关于双子岛的研究成果。{CLEAR}我和秀力博士都认为{CLEAR}传说中的精灵盖欧卡{CLEAR}很可能就沉睡在双子岛最底部。{CLEAR}如果你也想一睹盖欧卡的真容,{CLEAR}就跟我一起到双子岛最深处看看吧。
strings.en: A while ago, Professor Hale, an expert{NEWLINE}on Pokémon legends, visited Kanto, so I{CLEAR}talked with him about my research on{CLEAR}the Seafoam Islands.{SCROLL}Professor Hale and I both think the{NEWLINE}legendary Pokémon Kyogre is likely{CLEAR}sleeping at the very bottom of the{CLEAR}Seafoam Islands.{SCROLL}If you want to see Kyogre with your own{NEWLINE}eyes, come with me to the depths of the{CLEAR}Seafoam Islands.

strings.zh: 刚刚有一群人突然冲下来,{NEWLINE}说什么要捕捉急冻鸟、盖欧卡,{CLEAR}拜托你阻止一下他们吧！
strings.en: A group of people just rushed down{NEWLINE}here, saying they’d catch Articuno and{CLEAR}Kyogre! Please, stop them!

strings.zh: 火箭队的这场动乱让我明白了,{NEWLINE}造成天灾的从来都不是口袋妖怪,{CLEAR}而是滥用精灵力量的坏人。
strings.en: All this chaos with Team Rocket taught{NEWLINE}me something. It’s never Pokémon that{CLEAR}cause disasters. It’s bad people who{CLEAR}abuse their power.

strings.zh: 大事不好,盖欧卡和急冻鸟{NEWLINE}都被火箭队抓走了,{CLEAR}这下子可能要引发生态灾难了！
strings.en: This is terrible! Team Rocket has taken{NEWLINE}both Kyogre and Articuno! This could{CLEAR}set off an ecological disaster!

strings.zh: 小霞『{VAR:0103:0}你来的正好,{NEWLINE}火箭队干部已经进入洞穴深处了,{CLEAR}咱们必须马上追过去才行。
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}, you’re just in time! The{NEWLINE}Team Rocket Executives have gone deep{CLEAR}into the cave. We have to go after them{CLEAR}right now.

strings.zh: 站住！这里禁止通行！
strings.en: Halt! No one goes past here!

strings.zh: 谁敢再前进就是死路一条！
strings.en: Anyone who takes another step is a{NEWLINE}dead man!
strings.notes: tone review: 死路一条 is a death threat; kept as 'a dead man' (D-0627)

strings.zh: 小霞『想挡住我们？真是不自量力。
strings.en: Misty: You think you can stop us? Don’t{NEWLINE}make me laugh.

strings.zh: 小霞『{VAR:0103:0}让他们见识见识{NEWLINE}联盟冠军和道馆馆主的组合{CLEAR}到底有多强！
strings.en: Misty: {VAR:0103:0}, let’s show them just{NEWLINE}how strong a League Champion and a Gym{CLEAR}Leader are together!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『我在海上漂的时候,{NEWLINE}听一个探险者说起过双子岛的冰壁,{CLEAR}说这是无法通过的叹息之墙。{CLEAR}吉尔露太老弟你说自己能破除冰壁,{CLEAR}到底是什么办法？
strings.en: Archie: When I was drifting at sea, I{NEWLINE}heard an explorer talk about the ice{CLEAR}wall in the Seafoam Islands.{SCROLL}He called it an impassable Wall of{NEWLINE}Lamentation.{SCROLL}Lawrence, my friend, you said you could{NEWLINE}break through it. How?
strings.notes: 叹息之墙 (Wall of Lamentation) is a Saint Seiya reference.

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『哈哈哈,那我就展示一下{NEWLINE}咱们R计划的成果。{CLEAR}出来吧,火焰鸟！
strings.en: Lawrence: Ha ha ha! Then allow me to{NEWLINE}show you the fruits of our Project R.{CLEAR}Come out, Moltres!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『哦？火焰鸟的洗脑已经完成了？
strings.en: Archie: Oh? Moltres’s brainwashing is{NEWLINE}complete?

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『没错,它现在已经{NEWLINE}完全听命于我了。
strings.en: Lawrence: Indeed. It now obeys me{NEWLINE}completely.

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『火焰鸟,用你的热焰{NEWLINE}融化这些冰壁。
strings.en: Lawrence: Moltres, melt these ice walls{NEWLINE}with your blazing heat.

strings.zh: 火焰鸟『Mooo——tre！
strings.en: Moltres: Mooo-tre!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『太好了,这下畅通无阻了。
strings.en: Archie: Excellent. Now nothing stands in{NEWLINE}our way.

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『来吧,急冻鸟,{NEWLINE}你也成为我们火箭队的一员吧！
strings.en: Lawrence: Come, Articuno. You shall join{NEWLINE}Team Rocket as well!

strings.zh: 宝石海星『Staaa——mi！
strings.en: Starmie: Staaa-mi!

strings.zh: 小霞『呼……终于追上了。
strings.en: Misty: Phew... We finally caught up.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『看起来还来得及！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Looks like we’re still in time!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『切,麻烦的家伙来了。
strings.en: Archie: Tch. Here come the pests.

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『水吾桐,你先走。{NEWLINE}我来帮你挡住他们。
strings.en: Lawrence: Go on ahead, Archie. I’ll hold{NEWLINE}them off for you.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『他们这是又想拖延时间！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: They’re trying to stall us{NEWLINE}again!

strings.zh: 小霞『不必跟这个黑心商人废话,{NEWLINE}咱们速战速决！
strings.en: Misty: No point talking to this crooked{NEWLINE}merchant. Let’s finish this fast!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『想跟我速战速决？{NEWLINE}哼哼,今天的我可是有点不一样哦。
strings.en: Lawrence: Finish me fast? Heh heh. I’m a{NEWLINE}little different today, you know.

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『哈……啊……,不愧是联盟冠军,{NEWLINE}用了两只传说中的精灵都压制不住你。
strings.en: Lawrence: Hah... Ah... As expected of{NEWLINE}the League Champion.{SCROLL}Even two legendary Pokémon couldn’t{NEWLINE}hold you down.

strings.zh: 小霞『我们没时间在这跟你废话！{NEWLINE}宝石海星准备攻击！
strings.en: Misty: We don’t have time for your{NEWLINE}nonsense!{SCROLL}Starmie, get ready to attack!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『拖住你们这么久,{NEWLINE}水吾桐那边应该也差不多了。{CLEAR}我就先拜拜喽。
strings.en: Lawrence: I’ve kept you busy long{NEWLINE}enough.{SCROLL}Archie should be about done by now.{SCROLL}I’ll be taking my leave. Ta-ta!

strings.zh: 小霞『走,{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}快去看看水吾桐在前面干什么。
strings.en: Misty: Come on, {VAR:0103:0}! Let’s go see{NEWLINE}what Archie’s up to up ahead.

strings.zh: 水吾桐『盖欧卡！{NEWLINE}我以蓝色宝珠的名义召唤你。{CLEAR}醒过来吧！
strings.en: Archie: Kyogre! In the name of the Blue{NEWLINE}Orb, I summon you. Awaken!

strings.zh: 盖欧卡『Kyyy——ooo！
strings.en: Kyogre: Kyyy-ooo!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『太棒了,我从来没见过{NEWLINE}这么充满压迫感的精灵！{CLEAR}从现在起你就是我们火箭队的一员了！
strings.en: Archie: Magnificent! I’ve never seen a{NEWLINE}Pokémon with such presence!{SCROLL}From now on, you’re a member of Team{NEWLINE}Rocket!

strings.zh: 小霞『住手！水吾桐！
strings.en: Misty: Stop it, Archie!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『真遗憾啊,臭小鬼们。{NEWLINE}你们终究是来迟一步。{CLEAR}我现在要带盖欧卡回去洗脑了,{CLEAR}你们就等着被它引来的洪流吞没吧,{CLEAR}哈哈哈哈！
strings.en: Archie: Too bad, brats. You’re one step{NEWLINE}too late in the end.{SCROLL}I’m taking Kyogre back to be{NEWLINE}brainwashed now. Just wait for its{CLEAR}floods to swallow you all! Ha ha ha ha!

strings.zh: 小霞『给我站住！
strings.en: Misty: Get back here!

strings.zh: 小霞『……{SCROLL}……{SCROLL}小霞『唉……怎么这样！{NEWLINE}代代相传的宝珠居然在我手上弄丢了,{CLEAR}还被火箭队拿来召唤了盖欧卡。{CLEAR}我这个馆主当的真是太不称职了……
strings.en: Misty: ...{SCROLL}...{SCROLL}Misty: Oh... How could this happen? The{NEWLINE}Orb handed down for generations, lost{CLEAR}on my watch...{SCROLL}And now Team Rocket has used it to{NEWLINE}summon Kyogre. I’m such a failure as a{CLEAR}Gym Leader...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小霞,这件事不能怪你,{NEWLINE}是火箭队使用的手段太卑鄙。{CLEAR}等以后再跟他们战斗时,{CLEAR}咱们还是可以把蓝色宝珠抢回来的。{CLEAR}与其在这里自责,{CLEAR}不如打起精神磨炼自己,{CLEAR}为下一次跟火箭队的战斗做好准备。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Misty, this isn’t your fault.{NEWLINE}Team Rocket just played dirty.{SCROLL}Next time we fight them, we can still{NEWLINE}take the Blue Orb back.{SCROLL}Instead of blaming yourself here, pull{NEWLINE}yourself together and train.{SCROLL}Let’s get ready for our next fight with{NEWLINE}Team Rocket.

strings.zh: 小霞『嗯……{VAR:0103:0}你说的对,{NEWLINE}身为道馆馆主我不能被情绪左右。{CLEAR}我现在要回华蓝道馆好好思考一下{CLEAR}该怎么找回蓝色宝珠。{CLEAR}{VAR:0103:0}你以后如果有什么线索了,{CLEAR}要及时跟我说哦。
strings.en: Misty: Mm... You’re right, {VAR:0103:0}. As a{NEWLINE}Gym Leader, I can’t let my feelings get{CLEAR}the better of me.{SCROLL}I’m going back to the Cerulean Gym to{NEWLINE}think hard about how to get the Blue{CLEAR}Orb back.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, if you find any leads, tell me{NEWLINE}right away, you hear?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『现有的情报都调查完了,{NEWLINE}回联盟总部报告一下吧。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ve looked into all the leads{NEWLINE}I have.{SCROLL}Time to report back to League HQ.
